comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 ESSB EER Appendix D pages40–41 establishes the revised post-2023 curriculum:60EC each year, one consistent specialisation and25EC regulated choice space. The public overview uses some different labels (Human Learning; Memory), so formal names and weights control. Test-subject hours are a separate compulsory non-credit obligation. Articles3.6,4.1–4.3,7.4 and AppendixB govern choices, progression, participation and completion. Brain & Cognition is retained through the official-order tie-break, not a claim that neuroscience is the least specialised form of psychology.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The generic target does not select a specialisation. None of four substantive specialisations is established as broadly representative or least specialised. progressionAssessment.rationale: Research Methods & Statistics begins in Semester 2 before multivariate statistics and advanced research. Introduction to Brain & Behavior precedes the clinical, developmental and cognitive courses requiring it. Sociology progresses from introduction through modern theory to contemporary civil-society research. Epidemiology supplies specific population-health evidence; leadership and behavioural economics supply applied settings for psychological decisions.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Three substantive responses survive the source-content challenge. The closest has broad psychology as its organising subject; brain/cognition has four cognition courses plus psychological inquiry and specific biological/computational methods; the organisational option has organisational behaviour, leadership and behavioural research. Clinical and educational directions are evidenced but no fourth programme is authorised by the maximum-three rule. None reproduces Erasmus professional practicals, test theory or required thesis.

notes.text: Erasmus includes a dedicated psychometrics sequence, psychodiagnostic and communication practicals, a 14-EC thesis and a formal specialisation. UCR offers substantial psychology, cognitive-science and organisational study, including psychological assessment concepts and R-based research synthesis, but does not reproduce those specialist practicals or the same disciplinary degree. Becoming a clinical psychologist requires further qualifications; neither bachelor alone provides professional registration.

audience.programmeDescription: The English-taught International Bachelor in Psychology at Erasmus University Rotterdam studies behaviour, thought, emotion and development through psychological theory, empirical research and statistics. Students complete practical training, choose one of four specialisations and write a bachelor thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR options pursue broad psychology, brain and cognition, or psychology in organisations. Each has substantial psychological content and empirical methods, with different complementary study. Shared rows indicate specific partial subject or method relationships. Blank cells preserve gaps in specialist training, and none of these programmes guarantees admission to a psychology master or professional qualification.
